checks.name: Instruction-cache capacity
checks.supported_observation: ICC serves a TPC; GCC caches instructions at GPC level and fetches misses fromL2.
checks.model_impact: Add instruction-cache hierarchy scope to specification.
checks.limit: 16KiB baselinecapacity is not established by this source.

checks.name: Divergence handling
checks.supported_observation: Volta-and-later retain per-thread PC and call stack; active threads regroup into SIMT units.
checks.model_impact: Retain enabled-lane execution and per-thread state.
checks.limit: Private schedulingpolicy and transistor implementation not given.

checks.name: Reconvergence handling
checks.model_impact: Annotate convergence-token model as implementation hypothesis.

checks.name: Instruction-class routing
checks.supported_observation: Some instructions dynamically select among pipelines; some consume both pipelines.
checks.model_impact: Routing must allow opcode-specific alternatives/shared demands.
checks.limit: Exact sm120 opcode routing not fully listed.

checks.name: Pipeline sharing rules
checks.supported_observation: Nsight pipeline names may be logical aggregations rather than individual physical units.
checks.model_impact: Do not turn metric pipeline names into independent physical resource counts.

checks.name: L1 write policy
checks.supported_observation: st.cg explicitly bypassesL1; globalL1 is notcoherent.
checks.model_impact: Key modeled writepolicy by actual cacheoperator/nativepath.
checks.limit: Default st.wb does not establish universal L1 bypass/noallocation.

checks.name: L2 write policy
checks.supported_observation: Default st.wb uses writeback at coherent cachelevels.
checks.model_impact: Retain writeback contract; distinguish it from writeallocate assumption.
checks.limit: Writeallocation and controller acknowledgment details unestablished.

checks.name: L2 replacement policy
checks.supported_observation: Cache operators provide normal/evict-first hints; they do not alter memoryconsistency.
checks.model_impact: Policy hints constrain qualitative priority, not pseudoLRU selection.

checks.name: Barrier participant rules
checks.supported_observation: CTA has16 numbered barriers; implicitcountallCTAthreads, explicitcountwarp multiple.

checks.name: Barrier generation rules
checks.limit: Generation encoding and internal counters unknown.

checks.name: Barrier drain obligations
checks.supported_observation: Prior participant memory operations must be performed relative to participants at completion.
checks.limit: Does not require all unrelated arithmetic results or globalDRAMpersistence.

checks.name: L2 slice organization/count
checks.supported_observation: RTX5090 has placement-dependent L2 path; primarypaper declines exact slice-to-controller mapping.
checks.model_impact: Allow topology-sensitive latency observation separately from assumed48/64slices.
checks.limit: One NUMAlatency group is not one physicalslice.

checks.name: L2 slice address mapping
checks.supported_observation: Measured RTX5090 latency-probe pattern has512-byte period.
checks.model_impact: Use periodicity as a testable prior for address-dependent path variation.

checks.name: L2 read-hit latency
checks.model_impact: Widen external effective-path sensitivity range beyond356cycles ifusingthis prior.
checks.limit: One device; isolated dependentchain; includes fabric/dependency effects, notintrinsicL2taglatency.

checks.name: Read command/response timing
checks.supported_observation: RTX5090 DRAM-access distribution clusters at922cycles afteroutlierfiltering.
checks.model_impact: Add external end-to-end readpath comparison target.
checks.limit: Do not replace controller-only200cycle baseline directly; measurement includes load/sharedsink/timer path.

checks.name: Instruction-class result latencies
checks.limit: Notregister-read/collector/execution decomposition;paper has broaderarchitectural claims needingISAqualification.
